introduction_markdown:
Answer both questions beginning each answer on a new page in the answer booklet. Both answers carry equal marks.

Credit will be given for accuracy, correct use of a variety of expressions, verbs, vocabulary and idioms.

Use blue ink only.

You are reminded of the necessity for orderly presentation of your answers.
enonce_intro_markdown:
*Using a tense suitable to your chosen topic, write an essay in French, of at least 140 and not more than 150 words, (not counting figures, words in brackets, abbreviations and names of people or places) on ONE of the following topics.*

*Credit will be given for the correct use of a variety of expressions, verbs, vocabulary and idioms.*

*If you choose topic (b), the letter, your name must be AKIM and your address Lycée d'Oman.*

*Use of a different name and /or address will be seriously penalised. This holds true for details that can help reveal your true identity, school and/or family. The usual introduction to the letter must not be more than 20 words.*

*If you choose topic (c), your essay must be based on the events in the picture.*

*Off-topic material will earn no marks.*
incertitudes: Le sujet imprimé dit « Two Hours » : duree_epreuve vaut donc "2h" (la session 2023 avait "1h30"). Structure identique à 2023 : traduction (80 points) puis un essai à choisir parmi 3 sujets (80 points).

Sujet (b) : le sujet ne dit pas si le candidat tutoie ou vouvoie son oncle Tassa. Le corrigé retient le tutoiement (« Cher oncle Tassa »), usuel pour un oncle ; le vouvoiement serait aussi accepté s'il est tenu jusqu'au bout.
Sujet (b) : l'introduction habituelle de la lettre (lieu, date, salutation) fait 8 mots dans le modèle, sous la limite de 20 mots du sujet.

questions.corrige_markdown:
**Tense chosen:** the passé composé for what the uncle did during the holidays, the present for the thanks, the change in the writer's life and the lessons, and the future for the closing promise. The letter has a place and date, a salutation, a body and a closing formula, and it is signed *Akim* with the address *Lycée d'Oman* as required. The usual introduction (place, date and salutation) is 8 words, under the 20-word limit.

**Model essay** (150 words counted with the heading and signature; 143 without the names of people and places and the figure)

Lycée d'Oman, le 5 septembre

Cher oncle Tassa,

Je viens te remercier de tout cœur pour les vacances que j'ai passées chez toi à Kanse town. Ces vacances ont été merveilleuses. Tu t'es très bien occupé de moi.

D'abord, tu m'as accueilli chaleureusement et tu m'as donné une chambre confortable. Ensuite, tu m'as aidé à faire mes devoirs chaque soir. Enfin, tu m'as emmené rendre visite à tes amis et visiter la ville, ce que j'ai beaucoup apprécié. Chaque jour, tu me parlais avec patience et tu me conseillais.

Ta générosité a changé ma vie : j'ai repris confiance en moi et je travaille avec plus de courage. Je veux désormais réussir mes études.

De cette expérience, j'ai appris qu'il faut aider les autres sans rien attendre, partager ce que l'on a et rester reconnaissant. Je ferai de même pour d'autres un jour.

Je t'embrasse très fort.

Ton neveu,

Akim

**Notes**

The letter follows the three bullet points: three things the uncle did (paragraph 2: welcome and bedroom, help with homework, visits), how his generosity changed the writer's life (paragraph 3), and the lessons learnt (paragraph 4). The name Akim and the address Lycée d'Oman are imposed by the topic; names of people and places are not counted in the word limit. The model uses *tu* for an uncle; *vous* is also accepted if it is kept throughout.

**Marking criteria**

| Criterion | What earns the marks |
|---|---|
| Accuracy | Correct verb forms, agreements, spelling and accents; correct use of the tense chosen |
| Variety of expressions | Linking words (*d'abord*, *ensuite*, *enfin*, *heureusement*) and set phrases |
| Variety of verbs | Several different verbs instead of *être*, *avoir* and *faire* only |
| Vocabulary and idioms | Words and expressions suited to the topic; idioms used correctly |
| Relevance and length | All three bullet points covered; between 140 and 150 words |

**Common mistakes**

1. Using a different name or address from the imposed ones (AKIM, Lycée d'Oman), or writing an introduction longer than 20 words. Both are seriously penalised.
2. Listing only one or two things the uncle did instead of three, or mixing *tu* and *vous* in the same letter.
